description: Read a bed's layout grid: the bed's dimensions (cm) plus each placed planting's footprint (xCm, yCm from the bed's top-left; wCm × hCm), and any active plantings not yet placed. Use to reason about space — e.g. "is there 60 cm free at the front of Bed 2?". Positions are written by place_planting.

garden.description: Garden name; defaults to the user's first garden.

name: get_bed_layout
title: Get a bed's layout
